Subject. Julius KLEFFEL - communication dated May 6, 1939 from
American Consulate-General
Made by. D. S. Pitts Forwarded by. C. Crawford 8 J

Julius KLEFFEL, German, was born in
Shanghai on November 11, 1893. Educated in
Germany, he returned to Shanghai prior to the
start of the Great War and later took part in the
defence of Tsingtao. Finally taken prisoner
he was interned in Japan and eventually released
in January 1920, after which he returned to Shanghai.

KLEFFEL, in the early 20s, joined the
American-Oriental Banking Corporation in a minor
capacity and later worked himself up to the
post of Vice-President and General Manager of the
concern. He held that position until May 24,
1935 when the Bank closed its doors and applied
for liquidation.

During his years in the banking business in
Shanghai, he was known as a brilliant exchange man
and was in charge of the exchange transactions of
the bank.

After the Bank had closed and a liquidator
had been appointed, KLEFFEL assisted the liquidator
for several months in unravelling the tangle in
which the concern's financial affairs were.

Well-known in practically all local foreign
communities, KLEFFEL is married to an American
lady who is now a German citizen.

In February, 1936, information was laid with
the Municipal Police following which KLEFFEL was
charged with Breach of Confidence contrary to

主题：朱利叶斯·克莱费尔（Julius KLEFFEL）——美国总领事馆1939年5月6日来函
制作人：D. S. Pitts 转呈人：C. Crawford 8 J

朱利叶斯·克莱费尔（Julius KLEFFEL），德国人，1893年11月11日出生于上海。他在德国接受教育，在第一次世界大战爆发前返回上海，并随后参与了青岛的防御战。最终被俘后，他在日本被拘禁，直至1920年1月获释，之后返回上海。

20世纪20年代初，克莱费尔以初级职员身份加入美亚银行（American-Oriental Banking Corporation），后来逐步晋升至该机构的副总裁兼总经理职位。他担任该职直至1935年5月24日，当时该银行停业并申请清算。

在上海从事银行业期间，他以杰出的外汇专家闻名，并负责该行的外汇交易业务。

银行停业并任命清算人后，克莱费尔协助清算人数月，梳理该机构混乱的财务事务。

克莱费尔在当地几乎所有外籍社群中均广为人知，他娶了一位美国女士为妻，其妻现为德国公民。

1936年2月，有人向工部局警务处提供情报，随后克莱费尔被指控违反

After a lengthy trial in the First Shanghai
Special District Court, KLEFFEL was found guilty
of successive breach of confidence and sentenced
on March 10, 1936 to six months imprisonment
and a fine of $1,000.

Upon appeal to the Supreme Court in Nanking,
in September 1937, KLEFFEL's sentence was
upheld but punishment was suspended for two years.

Apart from the foregoing, nothing of a
detrimental nature is known against KLEFFEL.

经过上海第一特区地方法院的漫长审判，克莱费尔被判连续犯背信罪成立，并于1936年3月10日被判处六个月监禁及罚款1,000元。

1937年9月，在向南京最高法院上诉后，克莱费尔的判决得以维持，但缓刑两年执行。

除上述情况外，未发现对克莱费尔不利的其他劣迹。
